items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: he goes, “You know what Monk said?” I said, “What, teacher.” And he said, “The hippest thing I ever did was lay out.”

ctx.x: And I’m so surprised that it’s not in people’s sort of library of things to do.
Me too. You know one time when I was a kid, and I’m sure it’s cause I was just mindlessly clomping away, but my teacher said — this was in my first ensemble in © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
Pittsburgh as a kid — he’s staring at me, he goes, “You know what Monk said?” I said, “What, teacher.” And he said, “The hippest thing I ever did was lay out.”
